notes.title: OG Walkthrough - DreamWorks Dragons: Legends of the Nine Realms | Episode 7
notes.notes:
Dragons! We’ve got a new addition to the crew, Feathers 🐲. She wields the power to cloak her-self and mimic other dragons, like Night Lights . 
In this dark and eerie rift stay on the lookout for a new nightmare dragon, Flightmare, as well as, Deathgrippers and Guardian Skrills. Enlist the help of Feathers to figure out how to use the sonic crystals and, Plowhorn to ignite Gas Clouds with fire 🔥.
Together these dragons are unbeatable! 🎮

notes.title: OG Walkthrough - DreamWorks Dragons: Legends of the Nine Realms | Episode 6
notes.notes:
Dragons 🐉 A distant call from a dragon sets Thunder off in this mission in the Cauldron. Could it be a Night Light? 
Fly through this burning level 🔥 with Plowhorn, Wu and Wei and get one step closer to Thunder’s family.
Then feel the heat, and see the lava rise in the Earthquake. But that doesn’t stop the Catastrophic Quaken irruption on Thunder, Plowhorn and Wu & Wei. Will they survive it? 🎮

Calling all Dragons 🐲 

In the Fault, we come across the Fault Ripper and fire-breathing Gembreakers who aren't too excited about the presence of the Fault Ripper. See how we can dodge their red-hot wrath 🔥. 

Enter The Beast! Learn why the Fault Ripper is causing so much distress for the Gembreakers, and how they can aid Thunder on his journey. 🎮
